summary: Chunghwa Telecom filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing an announcement that it will host a teleconference for its third-quarter 2026 results on November 4, 2026, from 15:00 to 16:00 Taipei time, with presentation materials to be posted on its IR site and the Taiwan MOPS system after 14:30 that day. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or structural mechanic is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary earnings-notice current report, not a special situation; watch only for quarterly operating metrics and guidance.
